summary: Frontend-only verification of MULTI-WING framing solver + DRAG-PENETRATION persistence on the seeded Multi-Wing lead (e7b41ad7-cc50-4a56-ae70-30558c974c4a) / structure 'Multi-Wing House'. All 4 review-request checks PASSED.

verification_details.test_1_multi_wing_generate: Opened Roof Sketch editor for 'Multi-Wing House' and clicked data-testid='generate-proposed-btn'. data-testid='generate-readiness' = 'High confidence'. Canvas rendered a main gable (M1/M2 = 700 SF each, 11.18x60, 6/12) with TWO perpendicular wings of clearly DIFFERENT sizes projecting past the front eave: wing A (A1/A2 = 180 SF, 10.06x18) wider, wing B (B1/B2 = 95 SF, 6.7x14) narrower. FOUR valley segments visible (labels 9.0 LF, 9.0 LF, 13.0 LF, 13.0 LF -> total 44 LF valley matches measurements). 3 ridges (main + 2 wing). No pinwheel/overlap, no empty canvas, no 'Needs review'. 6 polygons rendered after adoption.
verification_details.test_2_pen_autoplaced_note: data-testid='generate-pen-autoplaced' present with text '1 penetration auto-placed on the roof — drag to fine-tune after adopting.' NO 'needs manual placement' text on page (count=0).
verification_details.test_3_use_proposed_and_pen_visible: data-testid='generate-use-btn' enabled and clickable. Toast 'Proposed sketch adopted. Review and Save when ready.' appeared. Pen rect rendered in main canvas at initial doc coords x=29.17, y=14.17 (on M2 centroid, on-plane, not at origin/off-canvas). Draggable via pointer.
verification_details.test_4_drag_and_persist: Dragged the pen rect via mouse.move+down/up by ~80x40 px. Pen doc coordinates updated to x=42.5, y=20.83. Clicked 'Save Sketch' -> Saved state; closed editor; reloaded lead page; clicked 'Edit Roof Sketch' to reopen. Pen rect re-rendered at EXACTLY x=42.5, y=20.83 — dragged position persisted across save + reload + reopen. 6 polygons (planes) also persisted.
verification_details.console_errors: No console errors during entire flow.

critical_code_review_comments: Proposal panel shows 'Measurements used: 0 planes · 0 roof lines' even though 6 planes and 4 valleys are actually being generated by the framing solver from the structure fixtures. The counter appears to only count what came directly from RoofMeasurement rows fed as input, not the solver output. Minor wording ambiguity — users may think nothing was used. Consider phrasing 'Auto-derived from N structure facets' or updating the counter to include solver-generated planes/edges.
seed_data_creation: None — used the seeded Multi-Wing lead/revision/structure as provided.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-wing (2 wings of different widths, 4 valleys, 6 planes) + drag-to-persist auto-placed penetrations verified end-to-end on lead e7b41ad7-cc50-4a56-ae70-30558c974c4a / structure 'Multi-Wing House'. After first save, the row button becomes 'Edit Roof Sketch' instead of 'Sketch Roof'; use flexible selectors. Note the 'Measurements used: 0 planes · 0 roof lines' cosmetic wording issue if further UX polish is planned.
